name: replay_hash
_: Determinism is a product feature: seed plus input log must give a bit identical replay, and Phase 4 moves real marbles on that promise. Two runs of the same six shot log agree; different seeds disagree, so the fingerprint is not a frozen value; and a stray Math.random injected into the world mid shot changes it, which is the self test. A taw that has left the ring returns to the edge for its next shot, six positions sixty degrees apart, each aimed back at the cross: that is the real rule and it is also what keeps the fixture bounded.

asserts.id: two runs of the same log agree
a stray Math.random inside the step is caught

_noise: A stray Math.random inside step() perturbs the world EVERY step, not once, so that is what the self test injects: a sub micron nudge on each of the first 240 steps. The magnitude is 1e-7 m and it is chosen from a measurement, not a feeling. The fingerprint quantises to 1e-6 m, and a sweep of injected drift found its sensitivity floor between 1e-8 and 1e-7 of relative velocity per step: at 1e-9 m per step only 18 to 20 of 20 seeds diverged, run to run, which is a FLAKY GATE and worse than none. At 1e-7 m per step the final state moves by about 4e-4 m, four hundred times the quantiser, and every seed diverges. A real Math.random bug is far larger than either. The floor also tells Phase 4 what it has: last bit float differences between two phones, around 1e-16, do not move this hash over one shot.
